_readme: Every coding question in an interview is picked from this list (never generated from the resume or job description). Edit freely: keep each 'number' unique; add categories or questions and restart the backend.

questions.text: Find the largest element in an array.
Find the second-largest element in an array.
Find the smallest and second-smallest elements.
Reverse an array.
Check whether an array is sorted.
Remove duplicates from a sorted array.
Move all zeros to the end of an array.
Find the missing number from 1 to N.
Find the element that appears only once.
Rotate an array to the right by K positions.
Find the maximum sum of a contiguous subarray (Kadane’s algorithm).
Find the union of two arrays.
Reverse a string.
Check whether a string is a palindrome.
Check whether two strings are anagrams.
Count vowels and consonants in a string.
Find the first non-repeating character.
Find the frequency of each character.
Remove duplicate characters from a string.
Find the longest common prefix among strings.
Check whether one string is a rotation of another.
Find the longest substring without repeating characters.
Implement linear search.
Implement binary search.
Implement bubble sort.
Implement selection sort.
Implement insertion sort.
Merge two sorted arrays.
Find the first and last occurrence of an element in a sorted array.
Find the position to insert an element into a sorted array.
Find two numbers that add up to a target (Two Sum).
Find all pairs whose sum equals a target.
Find the majority element in an array.
Find the intersection of two arrays.
Find the longest consecutive sequence.
Check whether a pair with a given sum exists in a sorted array.
Remove duplicates from a sorted array using two pointers.
Create and traverse a singly linked list.
Insert a node at the beginning or end.
Delete a node from a linked list.
Reverse a linked list.
Find the middle node of a linked list.
Detect a cycle in a linked list.
Find the Nth node from the end.
Merge two sorted linked lists.
Implement a stack using a list.
Implement a queue using a list or deque.
Check for balanced parentheses.
Implement a queue using two stacks.
Implement a stack using two queues.
Find the next greater element.
Evaluate a postfix expression.
Calculate factorial using recursion.
Print the Fibonacci sequence using recursion.
Find the sum of digits using recursion.
Reverse a string using recursion.
Generate all subsets of an array.
Solve the Tower of Hanoi problem.
Perform inorder, preorder, and postorder traversal.
Perform level-order traversal (BFS).
Find the maximum depth or height of a binary tree.
Count the nodes in a binary tree.
Search for a value in a Binary Search Tree (BST).
Insert a value into a BST.
Check whether two binary trees are identical.
Check whether a binary tree is balanced.
Represent a graph using an adjacency list.
Implement Breadth-First Search (BFS).
Implement Depth-First Search (DFS).
Count connected components in an undirected graph.
Detect a cycle in an undirected graph.
Find the Nth Fibonacci number using dynamic programming.
Solve the climbing stairs problem.
Find the minimum number of coins for a given amount.
Solve the 0/1 Knapsack problem.
